fusions.name: Snapped Branch
fusions.desc: Throws a branching head that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then shatters into spines that hit every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 60% of that. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Staghorn Thicket
fusions.desc: Raises a thicket of branching spines through a cone 4 tiles long that deals 26 damage to everything in it, ignores armour and leaves each enemy [Bleeding] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Fringing Reef
fusions.desc: Raises a reef of stinging spines 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Anything that crosses it is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Accreting Guard
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
